ourAdvices.title: Our Advices
ourAdvices.introTitle: How to choose the right care for your pet?
ourAdvices.introBody: Every pet is different — their coat, skin and lifestyle all play a role in choosing the right care routine. Our experts share their advice to help you pick the most suitable formulation for your companion.
ourAdvices.step1Intro: Every pet has different needs depending on their environment and daily routine.
ourAdvices.step1Bullet1: Indoor pets: even indoor pets benefit from a gentle, regular care routine.
ourAdvices.step1Bullet2: Outdoor pets: pets that walk, swim or play outside need more frequent care and protection.
ourAdvices.step2Intro: Our ranges are designed to suit different needs and lifestyles.
ourAdvices.step2Bullet1: For everyday care: choose a gentle, everyday formulation.
ourAdvices.step2Bullet2: For specific needs: opt for a targeted treatment suited to your pet's coat or skin.
ourAdvices.step2Bullet3: For multi-pet households: look for products safe to use across species.
ourAdvices.whyTitle: Why does the right routine matter?
ourAdvices.whyBody: The wrong products can cause discomfort, dryness or irritation. Using a routine adapted to your pet helps keep them comfortable while supporting their overall well-being.
ourAdvices.whenTitle: When should you apply this routine?
ourAdvices.whenBody: For best results, stay consistent throughout the year and follow the recommended usage on your chosen product, adjusting as your pet's needs evolve.
